summary:
L0 src/main.ml:14 — confirmed: unhandled exception on the changed call site.
L1 src/utils.ml:2 — refuted: style-only, no correctness impact.

findings.message: The `process` function can raise but the result is used without an exception boundary.
findings.failure_scenario: When `process new_value` raises, the main flow terminates before returning a fallback result.
findings.why_now: This PR changed the call site to use `process new_value` directly.
findings.suggested_fix: match process new_value with | exception exn -> log_error exn; 0 | result -> result

overall_assessment: One confirmed finding; the style lead was refuted.
